info.name: Meeting Room Booking API
info.description: End-to-end walkthrough of the business rules (R1-R12). Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or newman) against `docker compose up` (demo profile). Every run creates its own room and user (suffix {{runId}}), cancels its bookings and deactivates the room and user at the end.

exec: // Computes the dates used by every request, in the business zone (UTC+7).
// day = next Monday-Friday at least 2 days ahead, so bookings are valid (R2, R6, R7).
const day = new Date(Date.UTC(nowLocal.getUTCFullYear(), nowLocal.getUTCMonth(), nowLocal.getUTCDate() + 2));
const plus = (d, n) => new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate() + n));
// Every error must be an RFC 7807 problem.
// new run id per run, so rooms/users created below never clash with an earlier run
pm.test("role ADMIN", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role === 'ADMIN').to.be.true; });
pm.test("field errors listed", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(j.errors) && j.errors.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("is the demo user", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail') || j.email === pm.environment.get('userEmail')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("email stored lower-case", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.email === 'bob.' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId') + '@company.local').to.be.true; });
pm.test("no password in response", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.passwordHash === undefined && j.password === undefined).to.be.true; });

item.name: Bob logs in with initial password

exec: pm.test("3 field errors", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.errors.length === 3).to.be.true; });
pm.test("finds Bob", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.content.length === 1 && j.content[0].fullName.startsWith('Bob')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("renamed", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.fullName.startsWith('Bob Builder')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("active by default", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.active === true).to.be.true; });
pm.test("contains new room", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("3 equipment", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.equipment.length === 3).to.be.true; });
pm.test("time returned in +07:00", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.startTime.endsWith('+07:00')).to.be.true; });
pm.test("says who holds the slot", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.conflicts.length === 1 && j.conflicts[0].bookedBy.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("version bumped", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.version === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('version')) + 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("room not available", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(!j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("room available", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("smallest room first", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.every((r, i) => i === 0 || j[i - 1].capacity <= r.capacity)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("every room matches", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.every(r => r.capacity >= 6 && r.equipment.includes('PROJECTOR') && r.equipment.includes('TV'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("our room matches", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("2 bookings, in order", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.bookings.length === 2 && j.bookings[0].startTime < j.bookings[1].startTime).to.be.true; });
pm.test("owner name shown", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.bookings.every(b => b.bookedBy && b.bookedBy.fullName)).to.be.true; });

pm.test("demo user description hidden from Bob", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.bookings.filter(b => b.title === 'Sprint planning').every(b => b.description === undefined)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("descriptions visible", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.bookings.every(b => typeof b.description === "string")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("our room has 2 bookings", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.rooms.find(r => r.room.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId'))).bookings.length === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("contains my booking", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.content.some(b => b.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bookingId')))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("2 bookings", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalElements === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("only Bob", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.content.length === 1 && j.content[0].owner.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('bobId'))).to.be.true; });
pm.test("CANCELLED", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === 'CANCELLED' && j.cancelReason === 'Moved online').to.be.true; });

exec: pm.test("inactive", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.active === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test("not listed", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(!j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });

item.name: Admin still sees it with includeInactive

exec: pm.test("listed", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(r => r.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('roomId')))).to.be.true; });
